description: AquaFetch is a Python package for retrieving, parsing and harmonising water-resource datasets. The HyEx Research repository groups its interfaces into rainfall-runoff, surface-water quality and wastewater-treatment modules. It returns consistent data representations for catchment time series, catchment attributes, water chemistry and treatment experiments. A modeller can use these inputs for hydrological calibration or treatment-process comparisons. Its sources span multiple countries, with daily or hourly hydrological series where provided; coverage and measurement periods remain dataset-specific. The software is free through GitHub and PyPI under AGPL-3.0. A limitation is that one software interface does not harmonise every scientific assumption, measurement method or data licence across its upstream sources. No directly related catalogue record was established. This review verified the repository and its detailed dataset-interface description without downloading the underlying datasets or treating each listed source as a newly verified catalogue item.
